description: This file defines the PostObjectV4 class, which encapsulates the logic for generating a signed POST upload form for Amazon S3 using Signature Version 4 authentication. It manages form attributes, inputs, and policy/signature creation for secure file uploads to S3.

classes.name: PostObjectV4
classes.description: A class responsible for preparing signed POST form data for uploading objects to Amazon S3 with Signature V4.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PostObjectV4 instance with client, bucket, form inputs, options, and expiration time. Sets up form attributes, prepares policy and signature.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the S3 client instance used for generating the upload form.

methods.name: getBucket
methods.description: Returns the name of the S3 bucket.

methods.name: getFormAttributes
methods.description: Returns the form attributes array utilized in the POST upload form.

methods.name: setFormAttribute
methods.description: Sets a specific form attribute to a given value.

methods.name: getFormInputs
methods.description: Returns the form inputs array with necessary parameters for the upload.

methods.name: setFormInput
methods.description: Sets a specific form input field to a provided value.

methods.name: generateUri
methods.description: Generates the URI to be used as the form action, depending on client configuration and bucket name.

methods.name: getPolicyAndSignature
methods.description: Creates and signs the policy document for the POST upload, returning required signature and credential info.
